clipboard.heading: Clipboard
clipboard.includeTrailingNewline: Include trailing newline when copying selection

paste.heading: Paste
paste.accumulateTooltip: While the window is open, pasting multiple lines again appends after existing content. Turn off to replace with new content.
paste.accumulate: Accumulate content in multi-line paste window (off = replace)

messenger.heading: Mini Messenger
messenger.desc: Detailed settings such as display name, presence hiding, and popups can be changed in the Messenger workspace (💬) settings. Here only data reset is provided.
messenger.confirmDeleteUsers: Delete all discovered users and conversations?

mcp.heading: AI attachment MCP mode
mcp.desc: Choose how AI chat attachments are exposed to the CLI. The selected mode is used when you attach files or folders from the remote tree.
mcp.sshDesc: The CLI reads remote files directly over SSH using the current pepe_ssh MCP tools.
mcp.localDesc: Remote attachments are copied locally first, then the CLI reads them through a local filesystem MCP server.

font.heading: Font
font.claudeHint: Independent of terminal. Ctrl+Wheel in chat also adjusts size.

scrollback.heading: Scrollback buffer (lines)
scrollback.hint: Number of past output lines retained per terminal session (default: 10000)

wordSeparator.heading: Word separator characters
wordSeparator.hint: Characters that break word selection on double-click

contextMenu.heading: Explorer right-click menu
contextMenu.hint: Adds "Open PePe Terminal here" to the Windows Explorer right-click menu.
